# Wave 1 (singleton, Task 1): initial CR through wave commit

## 1. Initial code review

Stage all deliverables, then record the CR review tree for wave 1.

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Run the fix-delta tree block with `FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

- The printed SHA is **T0**, keyed to wave 1 / CR. It is also the pre-repair tree for the task.
- A nonzero exit stops dispatch and I report the error.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<filled ../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md>
DESCRIPTION: Wave 1 / Task 1 – number parsing (from implementer report)
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: <full Task 1 text, Tests: contract, spec /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
+ Leg/Rules context if present; ask: production-ready?` })
```

The review source is the staged plus unstaged checkout against 1111, not a commit range.

## 2. Repair dispatch

The supplied report is `FIX_FIRST` with one Moderate and `Behaviour-change: yes`.

- **No fan-out.** There is one actionable finding, and the integrated wave is not yet committed. Fix fan-out's source precondition therefore requires one in-place worker.
- **Loop position.** This is CR review 1, so fix 1 is dispatched.
- **Funded ledger.** Task 1's per-task ledger starts at zero, but no funded round is in play.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "implementer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<full Task 1 text + TEST_CONTRACT + Spec anchors numbers.md:8-10>
## Previous review report
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
<status protocol: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT>` })
```

The payload carries no commit or staging instruction.

## 3. After the worker returns

The worker returned `DONE`, but committed 2222… on its own, so HEAD moved.

- That commit is harmless. Fix delta is tree-based and step 7 folds worker commits.
- `WAVE_BASE_SHA` stays 1111… and `HEAD_SHA` stays `WORKTREE`.
- I never substitute `1111..2222` or `2222`-vs-worktree diffs.

Rerun the scoped gate:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test tests/parse.test.mjs)
```

That rerun passes (supplied). The new `tests/error.test.mjs` is not in the scoped set; it is exercised at the verify phase.

## 4. SR first (behaviour-change reroute)

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Rerun the same tree block (`FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`). This prints **T1**, keyed to Task 1 / SR.

Then produce the repair-only delta:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <T0> <T1>
```

It should contain only the `src/parse.mjs` empty-string rejection and the new `tests/error.test.mjs`. Initial wave content is already in T0, so it does not appear.

This is a post-integration SR, so it runs on the implementation worktree directly with no snapshot.

- It is SR loop review 2: the initial SR was review 1.
- It is dispatched as a first review, with no `## Previous review report` marker and no `TRAJECTORY:` line.
- It still carries `## Fix delta`.

```ts
subagent({ agent: "spec-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<full Task 1 text>
Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10 (read the anchored ranges yourself)
<Tests: block verbatim; Test: paths incl. tests/parse.test.mjs, tests/error.test.mjs>
Review starts from diff hunks; read touched files in full; never run tests.
## Fix delta
<output of git diff --binary T0 T1>` })
```

The supplied verdict is **COMPLIANT**, so the SR loop ends.

## 5. CR re-review

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Rerun the tree block, which prints **T2** for wave 1 / CR. T2 should equal T1, since nothing changed after SR.

Then produce the delta:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <T0> <T2>
```

```ts
subagent({ agent: "code-reviewer", async: false, cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<same filled template>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md>
## Fix delta
<output of git diff --binary T0 T2>` })
```

- This is CR review 2.
- `git diff 1111 -- .` against the worktree still shows the full wave, including content committed in 2222.

The supplied verdict is **SHIP**. Any Minors would not be carried, and the loop ends.

## 6. Fold, commit, complete (only after SR COMPLIANT and CR SHIP)

```bash
git -C /workspace/project reset --soft "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111" \
  && git -C /workspace/project add -A \
  && git -C /workspace/project commit -m "Task 1: number parsing (reject empty string)"
```

This yields one wave commit whose parent is 1111…, absorbing 2222…. If the commit came out empty, I would stop rather than complete the task. The tree is left clean for the next wave.

Then mark the wave's tracker index complete:

```ts
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: <Task 1 index>, status: "complete" })
```

The index stayed `in_progress` throughout until this point.

## Empty repair delta

If `diff T0 T1` were empty, the worker changed no tracked file. That can happen even with a new commit, since an identical tree still diffs to nothing, or with ignored-only output. In that case:

1. Dispatch no SR or CR re-review.
2. Count a failed attempt under When a Subagent Fails.
3. Resend the prior report with "your fix changed no tracked file".
4. Stop after the two-attempt limit; Task 1 stays `in_progress` pending the human.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Below are proposed commands and dispatches, not execution claims. In payloads, `TASK_1`, `TESTS_CONTRACT`, and `SPEC_ANCHORS` mean the supplied full task text, verbatim Tests block and Test paths, and anchors `/workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10`. They must be expanded when dispatching.

### 1. Stage and capture the initial CR tree

Keep `WAVE_BASE_SHA` fixed despite any subsequent worker commit.

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1

CR1_TREE=$(
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'Task 1 / initial CR tree: %s\n' "$CR1_TREE"
```

Initial dispatch, using the supplied code-reviewer template:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review the integrated singleton wave for production readiness.
Read TASK_1, TESTS_CONTRACT, SPEC_ANCHORS and applicable Rules.
DESCRIPTION: Integrated src/parse.mjs and new tests/parse.test.mjs;
initial SR accepted and scoped tests passed.
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: TASK_1
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs
Use the supplied code-reviewer template and report format.
Review staged and unstaged changes against BASE_SHA, not HEAD~1.
`
})
```

Its review source is:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 -- .
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 -- .
```

### 2. Repair after the supplied `FIX_FIRST`

This is an uncommitted integrated wave: dispatch **one in-place worker**, not a worktree fan-out. Give it no commit or staging instruction.

```js
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Repair Task 1 in the current integrated checkout.
Task Description: TASK_1
Read authoritative spec /workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md,
anchors 8-10, and applicable Rules before acting.
TEST_CONTRACT: TESTS_CONTRACT
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.mjs

Reject empty strings and add the requested tests/error.test.mjs coverage.
Self-review and report test-contract evidence.
Return explicitly DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED.

Prior review report, verbatim:
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
`
})
```

The supplied worker observation is `DONE`, with commit `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. Do not replace the wave base with that commit.

### 3. Test, capture, and obtain the repair-only delta

After that observation:

```bash
(cd /workspace/project && node --test tests/parse.test.mjs) || exit 1
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1

SR_TREE=$(
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'Task 1 / repair SR tree: %s\n' "$SR_TREE"
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary "$CR1_TREE" "$SR_TREE" > /tmp/task1-fix.delta || exit 1
```

This delta compares captured **trees**, excluding the original accepted implementation even though the worker moved HEAD.

### 4. Behavior-change reroute: SR first

```js
subagent({
  agent: "spec-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review Task 1's behavior-changing repair against TASK_1 and
/workspace/project/doc/specs/numbers.md:8-10. Read applicable Rules.
TESTS_CONTRACT, including tests/parse.test.mjs;
also review added tests/error.test.mjs.
Never execute tests.
## Fix delta
[verbatim contents of /tmp/task1-fix.delta]
Start from diff hunks with file:line; read each touched file in full.
Review the current integrated checkout.
`
})
```

This is the rerouted SR’s **first review of this repair**, so it has no previous-review marker or trajectory requirement. Its ordinal continues Task 1’s SR count. Proceed only after the supplied `COMPLIANT` observation.

### 5. Capture and dispatch CR re-review

```bash
git -C /workspace/project add -A || exit 1
CR2_TREE=$(
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) || exit 1
printf 'Wave 1 / CR re-review tree: %s\n' "$CR2_TREE"
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary "$CR1_TREE" "$CR2_TREE" > /tmp/task1-cr-fix.delta || exit 1
```

Dispatch foreground `code-reviewer`, `cwd: "/workspace/project"`, preserving initial requirements, base, `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE`, and scoped command. Append:

```text
## Fix delta
[verbatim contents of /tmp/task1-cr-fix.delta]

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes
```

Also append the complete **“Re-review: trajectory verdict”** block from the supplied code-quality-reviewer template verbatim.

### 6. Only after the supplied `SHIP`

```bash
git -C /workspace/project reset --soft 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 &&
git -C /workspace/project add -A &&
git -C /workspace/project commit -m "Fix number parsing and reject empty input"
```

Only on successful, nonempty commit:

```js
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: 1, status: "complete" })
```

Stop here.

An empty repair delta means no tracked repair occurred—even if HEAD moved. Dispatch no re-review; count a failed attempt and resend the report with “your fix changed no tracked file,” observing the existing two-attempt limit.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After keeps BASE_SHA 1111…/HEAD_SHA WORKTREE on both CRs with add -A before each review, uses the seeded scratch GIT_INDEX_FILE tree block for T0/T1/T2 with a tree-to-tree git diff --binary that excludes the already-reviewed wave content, dispatches one plain in-place implementer in /workspace/project with the verbatim report and no commit/staging instruction, routes the Behaviour-change: yes repair through affected-task SR (anchors, Tests contract, Fix delta, no snapshot) before CR re-review, reruns only the scoped command, and folds 2222… via reset --soft/add -A/commit before the tracker update, treating an empty delta as a failed attempt. Two small drifts to tidy without affecting the Change: After keys T1 to 'Task 1 / SR' while T0/T2 are keyed to 'wave 1 / CR' — keep one key per re-review chain (wave 1 / CR) so the T0→T1 delta is unambiguously the CR fix-delta reused by SR; and the unprompted asides ('Funded ledger… no funded round is in play', 'exercised at the verify phase', '+ Leg/Rules context if present') are harmless here but invite invented findings — drop them or phrase them as 'not applicable to this case' so the walkthrough stays strictly on the supplied observations.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: both CR dispatches carry BASE_SHA 1111… and HEAD_SHA WORKTREE after `git add -A`, the review source is explicitly a staged/unstaged diff against the base (`git diff --binary 1111… -- .`, 'not HEAD~1') rather than a commit range; CR1_TREE and SR_TREE/CR2_TREE are captured with a seeded scratch GIT_INDEX_FILE + add -A + write-tree and diffed tree-to-tree with `--binary`, excluding the already-reviewed implementation even though HEAD moved to 2222…, and an empty delta is treated as a failed attempt with no re-review; the repair is one in-place implementer at cwd /workspace/project with the FIX_FIRST report verbatim and an explicit statement that no commit or staging instruction is given; the Behaviour-change: yes repair goes to spec-reviewer against the integrated checkout with task, anchors, Tests contract and Fix delta before CR re-review; the scoped command runs alone, and the reset --soft / add -A / commit fold plus plan_tracker complete appear only after COMPLIANT and SHIP. Two wording choices are worth tightening so a strict reader doesn't wobble: (1) the standalone 'Its review source is: git diff …' block under step 1 could be misread as a substituted diff artifact—phrase it as 'what the reviewer reads inside the checkout' or fold it into the dispatch text; (2) the inline tree-capture block is repeated three times verbatim, which costs words against the 1000-word limit and invites divergence—Before's single `capture_review_tree()` function with 'each invocation runs the complete block' is tighter and still satisfies fix-only-delta. The added `context: "fresh"` and the unexpanded TASK_1/TESTS_CONTRACT tokens (with the 'must be expanded' caveat) did not move any fact, but inlining `${TASK_1_FULL_TEXT}`-style placeholders as Before did makes the verbatim-contract intent less dependent on the preamble.
